author: Leisler, 1812
habitat: 하천 부지, 해안의 풀 습지, 간척지, 삼각주
summary: 해마다 봄과 가을에 수십 마리가 지나가는 나그네새로, 중부 서해안 바닷가와 한강 같은 물가에서 작은 무리를 볼 수 있다. 하천 부지, 해안의 풀 습지, 간척지, 삼각주 등에 내려앉아 단각류 같은 갑각류, 지렁이, 곤충과 바닷가의 작은 무척추동물을 잡아먹는다. 해안 초원이나 호숫가 풀숲, 바다에서 멀리 떨어진 고원 산지의 오목한 땅에 둥지를 틀고 한배에 알 4개를 낳는다. 구북구 전역에서 번식하고 일본, 쿠릴 열도, 타이완 등에서 겨울을 난다.

art.subject: Temminck's Stint (Calidris temminckii), adult in breeding plumage, as seen on Korean riversides and wet fields in late April and May: crown and nape grey-brown with fine dark streaks; face plain grey-brown with an indistinct pale supercilium; mantle and scapulars mostly plain grey-brown with a scattering of feathers showing black centres and rusty-buff fringes; neck and breast grey-brown washed buff and finely streaked darker, forming a breast band cleanly cut off from the white belly; chin and throat white; undertail white. Bill short, fine and blackish; dark eye; legs dull yellowish-green to yellowish-brown.
art.pose: foraging in a small group along a muddy riverbank
art.scene: Korean riverside during spring migration: muddy bank and wet grassy margin of a wide river; no people, buildings or text
views: adult breeding plumage (late April–May), side view standing: grey-brown upperparts with scattered black-centred, rusty-fringed scapulars, buff-washed streaked grey-brown breast band, white chin and belly, short fine blackish bill, yellowish legs, tail tip projecting beyond the wingtips

adult non-breeding plumage (autumn), side view standing: plain grey-brown upperparts and a full grey-brown breast band, white throat and belly, like a tiny Common Sandpiper; same bill and yellowish legs
in flight, seen from above: grey-brown upperparts, narrow white wing-bar, dark centre to the rump and tail with pure white outer tail feathers
art.build: Tiny, rather elongated stint, about 14cm, about the length of a tree sparrow; low, horizontal stance, often crouching and creeping slowly on wet mud, short neck. Bill short (about head length or a little less), fine, nearly straight, sometimes very slightly drooping at the tip. Legs short, yellowish-green to yellowish-brown, never black. At rest the tail projects slightly beyond the folded wingtips, giving a long-rear-ended look. In flight a narrow white wing-bar and pure white outer tail feathers on each side of a dark tail centre.
avoid: Do not paint black legs; that is Red-necked Stint (Calidris ruficollis). Temminck's has yellowish legs.
Do not give it a brick-red face and throat (breeding Red-necked Stint); the breast is grey-brown with only a buff wash.
Do not paint long toes, a long neck, a bold white supercilium and bright rufous-edged upperparts; that is Long-toed Stint (Calidris subminuta).
Do not show the wingtips reaching beyond the tail.
